episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: An MI6 agent learns that there is a Russian asset in the UK Cabinet.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Kate suspects that her agent is in danger and, defying orders, prepares to rescue her.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Kate's bold rescue mission in Malta backfires and she draws flak from all sides.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The pressure mounts on Kate when the Russians target her family, and Rav follows clues to Geneva.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Kate runs Cyclops in an audacious mission inside Moscow Secret Service HQ to finally trap the MI6 mole.
